flow: Win-back: Ridgeview, 14 days since the core action (created a report)

trigger.summary: Segment-triggered campaign on 'LCM Win-back: ridgeview_winback_14d' (Every re-match)
flow_filters: has not done feature_used since entering
exit_criteria: conversion goal: performs feature_used; exit when the person converts

re_entry.plan: allowed after the person leaves the flow

trigger.holdout: split on the person property lcm_holdout_ridgeview_winback_14d (true goes to exit), written once and then weekly by the holdout sync (build/holdout_sync_<dialect>.sql, then lcm send --profile-updates): a segment trigger carries no event to read in_holdout from

segment.name: LCM Win-back: ridgeview_winback_14d
conditions: has performed onboarding_step_completed at least once
has not performed onboarding_step_completed within the past 14 days
has not performed feature_used within the past 14 days
segment.refresh: people enter the campaign when they match (Every re-match)
data_prerequisites: onboarding_step_completed and feature_used are tracked as Customer.io events

steps.action: True/False branch on the re-permission email click

split.condition: clicked the re-permission email since entering
split.platform_action: True/False branch on the re-permission email click

steps.note: set lcm_sunset = true: suppressed from marketing, record kept, lifted only by a fresh opt-in

settings.goal: created a report (feature_used where feature = reports); conversion goal: performs feature_used; exit when the person converts
send_windows: email: 08:00 to 21:00 recipient local (plan); a Time Window delay just before the message: 08:00 to 21:00, in the person's timezone attribute
frequency: Message limit: 3 messages across email/sms/push per 7 day(s), with this campaign opted in to message limits

manual_steps: Create the person property lcm_holdout_ridgeview_winback_14d (true or false). Run build/holdout_sync_postgres.sql and send its rows with `lcm send --profile-updates <results.csv> --platform customerio --approve`; repeat weekly so new people carry it before they can qualify
Data needed for the segment: onboarding_step_completed and feature_used are tracked as Customer.io events

Create the Customer.io data-driven segment 'LCM Win-back: ridgeview_winback_14d': has performed onboarding_step_completed at least once; has not performed onboarding_step_completed within the past 14 days; has not performed feature_used within the past 14 days
Make lcm_sunset = true a suppression in every marketing send

Entry filters to confirm (checked once at entry): completed onboarding (onboarding_step_completed where step_index = 3) at least once; clicked or replied to any email in the last 90 days (opens do not count: privacy proxies inflate them)

Suppressions on every step: unsubscribed from marketing email, or hard bounced; marked any message as spam (complaint), ever; sunset-suppressed (lcm_sunset is true); only a fresh opt-in lifts it; internal, test and seed addresses; currently in a higher-priority flow (by the frequency policy's flow_priority: billing, cart, post-purchase first); received a re-permission ask from any flow in the last 180 days
Before going live: send every message to a seed list, run `lcm simulate` on flow_spec.json, and get approval
